selection.search_budget_note: equal_number_of_configurations plus measured compute_budget; budget failures logged; no reward for extra dataset access
selection.ensemble: nonnegative_simplex_weights shrunk_to_equal using dedicated E window
selection.calibration: one slope_and_intercept sigmoid per_horizon; multiclass temperature; isotonic challenger only if enough_calibration_data
selection.selective_prediction: secondary only; fixed confidence_quantile thresholds selected before final_test; report 100/90/75/50 percent target_coverage curves

search_spaces.candidate_sampling: if Cartesian product exceeds 24, draw 24 without replacement with seed 20261008 before performance access
search_spaces.resource_limits: must set after development_sample_timing and before final_test; no hidden extra trials

time_splits.purge: exclude training_labels whose closed_information_interval overlaps heldout interval; use actual maturity for unresolved labels
time_splits.embargo: forward_only no_future_training; choose_extra_gap_from_development_dependency_analysis then freeze; no universal_day_count
time_splits.OOF_generation: E C D may use predeclared rolling base-model recipe; each scored label unseen at prediction; ensemble only E and calibration only C; final model never uses in-sample fitted scores as calibration examples

gate_rules: Brier improvement with valid calibration and no predeclared material subgroup harm
evaluation.sample_size: choose using development long_run_variance and material effect; 252 dates not assurance of sufficient_power

claim_policy.synthetic_checks: Synthetic checks do not certify market accuracy or investment returns.

monitoring.performance_review: predeclared checkpoints; no manual model changes during final window
monitoring.stop_on: data/contract/risk faults allowed; all stopped dates remain logged
